title: Tutorial: New and Updated - Everything You Always Wanted to Know About Optical Networking
summary: A two-hour NANOG tutorial by Richard Steenbergen aimed at network engineers, covering optical networking technologies. This is the updated 2017 edition of a recurring talk.
why: Commenters call it an invaluable, approachable way to learn how optical networking actually works.

quote.text: proved invaluable to me in learning optical networking
